cohort: The study included 120 female rats, divided into sham (20), control (50), and experimental (50) groups.
finding: The study successfully established a surgical-LPS-induced rat model of Cesarean Scar Diverticulum (CSD) that faithfully recapitulates clinical-pathological hallmarks, including endometrial-myometrial injury, fibrotic remodeling, and a chronic inflammatory microenvironment.
